contexts.text: They inflow into the right side of the brain with cupidities.
To the right hemisphere of the brain pertain the voluntary things. AC 3884.
(The antediluvians) are permitted to inflow into the right side of the head... and from the right of the head into the left of the chest. SE 3362. SE 3375.
Societies which are on the right, appear to the right, whichever way the body is turned... AC 3638. AC 3639. AC 4321:2.
At the Lord's right are the Angels, and evil Spirits at His left.
The moon appeared at the right.
If to the left, I will go to the right; and if to the right, I will go to the left () = separation.
Right and left are merely something relative. Explained.
The centre is wherever the Lord is; and right and left are from that. Example(s).
Round the left eye when they were communicating truth and affections of truth; round the right, when good and affections of good.
Those delighted with the Word, but not solicitous to understand it, had heat in the right arm.
To sit at the right hand of power = to have all Power...
He set his right foot upon the sea, and his left upon the earth (). Explained. AE 600.
The left eye = the Intellectual; the right eye () = the affection thereof.
At the right side from the Lower Earth rose up as it were a roll...
I will look to the right hand, or to the left () = reciprocal freedom. Explained.
(A place to the right, called the abode of the intelligent, where horses appear.)
To sit on the right hand = a state of power. Illustrated.
Dextrorsum, sinistrorsum. Occur.
The north and the right hand Thou hast created ()... The right hand = those nearer the light of good and truth. These are at the Lord's right hand. References. (Compare AC 10061:3.)
These appeared at the right.

Those who correspond to the right side of the brain, are those in the will of good, and thence in the will of truth; and those who correspond to the left side of it, are those in the understanding of good and truth, and thence in affection for them. This is because those in Heaven at the Lord's right are those in good from the will (called the celestial), but those at His left are those in good from the understanding (called the spiritual).
The Lord as a Sun constantly appears to the right... a little above the plane of the right eye.
The right side of the face together with the right eye, corresponds to the affection of good; the left, to the affection of truth.

The sight of the left eye corresponds to truths which are of the understanding; and the right eye, to the affections of truth, which are also of the understanding; consequently, the left eye corresponds to the truth of faith; and the right eye, to the goods of faith. (The reason explained.) ... For those in good are at the Lord's right, and those in truth at His left.
The Societies in paradisiacal things appear... a little to the right. AC 4529:3.

Benjamin means a son of the right hand, by which is signified spiritual truth which is from celestial good, and thence power, for good is in power through truth... The right hand = the highest power. Hence to sit at the right hand of God = a state of power from the truth which is from good, which, predicated of the Lord, is omnipotence, and also the Divine truth which proceeds from His Divine good. Illustrated. AC 10019:5, Illustrated.
He applied himself to the right ear.

He set the sheep on His right hand, and the goats on the left = separation according to truths from good, and falsities from evil. Those in truths from good actually appear at the right, and those in falsities from evil at the left. Hence to be set on the right hand, and on the left = to be ordinated according to the life. AC 10061:2. AE 600:5.
Every Spirit and Angel sees the good to the right, and the evil to the left. Described.
The right hand, in the Word, = higher power; and to sit at the right hand of Jehovah = omnipotence. Illustrated. AC 7281. AC 9807:6. AC 9809:3. DLord 14:8. DLord 35:10. DSS 49:2. DLW 221:2. AE 63:7.
(Magicians) are... at the right.
Under Left, see this reference.
(Such) are under the sole of the right foot.
Such dwell under the right heel.
Why those on the right hand are called the just. Explained.
(Those who act by artifices and lies) are circumrotated from left to right... Their Hell is in a deep place beneath the right foot...
(This) Spirit was perceived... beneath to the right. (He had been a pirate.)
These Hells (of cruel adulterers) are... partly beneath the right foot. SE 4545.
An inundation of cupidities... belongs to the right side of the brain; but one of Falsities, to the intellectual part, in which is the left side of it. SE 4155.

Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel's left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel's right hand () = the truth of the Intellectual as in the second place, and the good of the Voluntary in the first place. Explained. See AC 6269. AC 6287. AC 6292.
A great continuous stream (of people from the worlds) seen on the right...
(Spirits of Mercury) seen a little to the right.

Their speech was conveyed towards my left eye, although they were on the right; because the left eye corresponds to Knowledges of Things abstracted from material ones, thus to the things of intelligence; but the right eye to the things of wisdom.
The planet Mercury appears behind, a little towards the right.
Difference of state causes (Spirits) to appear... to the right, or to the left.
This was seen to the right...
The waters a wall... on their right hand and on their left () = withheld from falsities on all sides. Explained.
Thy right hand, Jehovah, was magnified in strength () = the omnipotence of the Lord. Explained, Illustrated. AC 8282.
The right hand, in the supreme sense, = the Lord as to Divine truth. Illustrated.
Thou stretchedst out Thy right hand () = the dominion of power over all things thence.

To the right and to the left, in the spiritual sense, = on every side; for right and left are not determinations to a certain quarter, but to every quarter... and still more so in the Spiritual World... for there that which is to the right appears to the right in every turning; in like manner that which is to the left.
Such (saints) appear to the right, backwards...

The affection of evil... is signified by the right eye offending; and the affection of falsity... by the right hand offending; for... the right eye corresponds to the good of faith, and, in the opposite, to the evil of faith... But the right hand corresponds to the power of truth from good, and, in the opposite, to the power of falsity from evil. AC 10061:5.
The right cheek-bone () = the affection of truth from good.
The right eye = falsity of faith concerning the Lord. This is what is to be plucked out.
To sit at the right hand of the Father = to be everything with the Father; thus to be Himself.
External or natural good was represented by a right foot ().

The like is signified by the two extremities (of the mercy-seat) as by the right and left hand of the Lord: by the right hand is signified the good of celestial love... and by the left hand, the good of spiritual love... Hence all the things on the right side of man correspond to celestial good, and those on the left, to spiritual good... Those in these goods are meant by to sit on the Lord's right and left hand ().

For the things on the right side of the body = goods (from which are truths); and those on the left, the truths thence. Enumerated. AC 9604:end. AC 9736. AC 9843. AC 10061. HH 118:end. DLW 127. DLW 384:2. AE 386:2.
The Lord as a Sun appears... opposite the right eye; and as a Moon, opposite the left eye. HH 118.
The right ear () = the perceptivity of truth from good. Illustrated.
To cast the net on the right side of the ship () = to act and teach from good.
In the opposite sense, the right = the evil from which is falsity; and the left, the falsity through which is evil. Illustrated.
In Heaven at the right are those who are in the light of truth, thus those in the south; but at the left those who are in the shade of truth, thus those in the north. HH 142. HH 151.
The right = good from which is truth; the left, truth through which is good. Illustrated.

When all the Spirits came (to the Lord's presence), the good were separated to the right, and the evil to the left, and this instantly as of their own accord; and those at the right were ordinated according to the quality of the good, and those at the left, according to the quality of the evil, with them.
The infants who are of a celestial genius, appear... to the right: and those of a spiritual one, to the left.

The way which tended to the left was narrow, leading through the west to the south, and thus into the light of Heaven; and the way which tended to the right was broad, leading obliquely downwards towards Hell.
In the spiritual sense, the right = good; and the left, truth.
The man of Thy right hand () = the Lord as to the Word; He is so called, because the Lord, from Divine truth, has power... See AE 298:6.
Those more in wisdom see the Lord obliquely to the right; those less in wisdom, obliquely to the left; therefore they are in the south and north respectively.

That love and wisdom may make a one with Angel and man, there are pairs in all things of his body... Thus there is a right and a left; and all their right parts relate to love from which is wisdom, and all their left parts to wisdom from love...
That the Angels... thus have the south to the right, the north to the left... Explained.
The right hand = higher power.

The natural mind gyrates from right to left; but the spiritual mind from left to right... Gyration from right to left is turned downwards... but gyration from left to right goes upwards... An evil Spirit cannot gyrate his body from left to right, but from right to left; whereas a good Spirit can with difficulty gyrate his body from right to left, but easily from left to right.

It is from this marriage (of love and wisdom) that in each and all things of the body there are a right and a left; and the right one relates to good from which is truth, and the left one to truth from good, thus to conjunction.
Having in His right hand seven stars () = that all the Knowledges... are from the Lord alone through the Word.
I saw in the right land of Him... () = Himself as to omnipotence and omniscience. Explained. AE 297. AE 298, Explained.

The reason darkness was caused when a window was made at the right side, was that light inflowing from Heaven from that side affects the will; and the reason light was caused when... a window was made on the left side, is that light inflowing from Heaven from the left side affects the understanding; and every man can be in the light of Heaven as to the understanding, provided the will as to its evil is closed.
A mark upon their right hand ()... The right hand = the whole of man as to intellectual power, and thus as to his faith... ( = the truth of faith in its power. AE 838.)
On this side and on that = on the right and on the left; and truth on the right is what is in clearness, and on the left, what is in obscurity; for the south, in Heaven, is to the right...
The bridegroom was on the left, and the bride on his right.

Why did she sit at his right hand? Because... wisdom is at the right hand of love... The right hand also = power, and love has power through wisdom; but after the wedding... the husband represents wisdom.
Bears were seen to the left, and leopards to the right.

There appeared red lightning on the right, and bright white lightning on the left (which were a sign to the wise one to say) that the right one of these pairs (of organs) = their good, and the left one their truth; and this is from the marriage of good and truth... Hence, in Heaven, the right eye is the good of sight, and the left the truth thereof; the right ear is the good of hearing, and the left the truth thereof; the right hand is the good of the power of man, and the left is the truth thereof... By the right eye and the right hand offending, He meant that if good becomes evil, the evil must be cast out... By casting the net on the right side, He meant that they should teach the good of charity...
To sit at the right hand of His Father, means the omnipotence of God through the Human which He assumed in the world... That the right hand = omnipotence. Illustrated.
Light from Heaven (caused) many of those on the left side to pass over to those on the right...
Two companies (then) went to the right, and two to the left; the latter descending, and the former ascending.

I have learned that the right side of man is accounted more holy than the left, and indeed so that the right side is never to be allowed to be touched except by holy things, but the left by other things.
Hence the right represents the husband, and the left the wife...
On the left side of the head are those who have despised... things which are good... on the right side, those who have despised truths.

The left eye corresponds to the right hemisphere of the brain, and the right eye to the left hemisphere; for so do the fibres flow... Thus the left eye, or the right side of the brain, represents the intellectual things of truth; and the right eye with the left side of the brain, the intellectual things of good.

That the things in the left side of the brain correspond to the right things in the body, has been given me to know by experience; for Spirits acted into the left of the brain, and a sense thence was derived through the fibres into the right of the nose, and into the right palm of the hand.
Thus the right side of the brain is allotted to intellectual things, and the left to affections. The reverse in the body...
When such a projection appears from right to left, he wants to separate himself from the Society; when from left to right, they want to retain him...
For the right eye represents affections.

Formerly... the natural operation... was shown in the whole face, both the changes of celestial things which belong to the right of the face, and those of spiritual things, which belong to the left of it. When the affections of good ceased... the operation into the right side of the face receded, and betook itself to the left, in which it acts from spiritual things, thus in inverted order; that is, not from celestial things to spiritual ones, or from right to left, but from spiritual things to celestial ones, thus from the left; but it is not allowable [to proceed] from left to right, or from spiritual things to celestial ones; and therefore the right of the face is guarded by the Lord...
Aristotle... thought from affection... and he therefore applied himself to my right ear; but his followers... from terms... and (therefore) they were at my left ear.
(That truths and Falsities have their place in the left side of the head, as cupidities have in the right, and can be found there. From experience.)
This Moon did not appear to the right, where the Lord is, but in front above.
Hypocritical Genii operate into the right side of the teeth, etc... and hypocritical Spirits into the left side.
By looking at the right side of his face.
At the right... are the deceitful... and the magicians.
At the right... are the brothels of the lascivious.
A gate (of Hell) at the right...
At the right... are those in the knowledge of faith, but a life of evil.
At the right... is a Hell... of violences done to charity from falsities.
The Moravians appeared a little to the right...
The region (of) the Mohammedans is towards the right, in the plane of the right sole.
I saw the Sun at the right. (A mountainous tract of Heaven to the right. Described.)
At the right side there appeared a dense and dark forest: thither are sent those in falsities... At the left side appeared precipices...
(Babylonians) appear... on the right and left side of the Sun... SE 4915. SE 4954.
On the right (in the churches there) are those in the good of love; on the left, those in the truths of faith... and in the middle, those who conjoin.
(In the evil cities there) at the right side, are those in evil through which is falsity; and at the left, those in falsity from evil...
A gulf at the right which is darker than the rest...
(These Babylonians) sit at the right, that is, towards the south...
The Jews appeared at the right...
He laid His right hand upon me () = life from Him. Explained.
In His right hand, when said of the Lord, = what is from Him. AE 96.
That the right hand, predicated of the Lord, = omnipotence and omniscience; and, when of men, power and wisdom. Fully illustrated.
The right hand = the Divine truth.
In the opposite sense, the right hand = falsity from evil. Illustrated.
The reason the right hand, when predicated of the evil, = falsity... is that the quarters with the evil are opposite to those with the good...
The right eye = the understanding of good; the left eye, the understanding of truth.
The right hand = the truth of good.
Called son of my right hand, because... the right hand = the power of truth from good...
The right side of the ship = that all things are from the good of love and of charity; for the right = this good ex quo. ( = that they should teach the good of life. AE 513:7.)
The right = all things of good from which is truth; and the left, all things of truth from good.
The signification of right and left as used separately, and both together. Explained and Fully illustrated.

(Hence) the right = truth in light, and the left, truth in shade; or, what is the same, the right = spiritual good... and the left, spiritual truth; thus also the right = good from which is truth, and the left, truth from good. Such things are signified by all the right and left parts of the body and head...

Let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doeth () = that good must be done from good, and for the sake of good, and not for the sake of self and the world in order that it may appear. (Further explained.)
The two robbers crucified, the one on the right, and the other on the left, of the Lord = the like as the sheep and the goats.
The reason the right eye, and the right hand, are mentioned, and not the left eye and hand. Explained.
At the right hand = in protection from conjunction with Him.
Sit at My right hand = omnipotence through Divine truth. Illustrated.
Let Satan stand at his right hand () = to be completely occupied by infernal falsity.
Satan stood at his right hand () = that falsity of doctrine fought against Divine truth.
The right hand = truth in light. Explained.
The organ or member on the right relates to good, and that on the left, to truth. DWis 3. 3.

At Thy right hand stands the queen ()... = the Church from the reception of good... For all things with man which belong to his right side, relate to good from which is truth Moreover, the woman is born to be the affection which is of love... thus to be good... and therefore... it is from Divine order for the wife to be on the right.

When in a state of reformation, the mind looks from truth to good, as if from left to right, which is contrary to order; but, after the mind has been conjoined with Heaven... it looks from right to left, that is, from good to truth, which is according to order.
The English appear a little to the right...
